name: cmh-cleaning-management
description: Local management system for CMH Cleaning

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: tsx --test server/src/lib/finance.test.ts server/src/lib/auth.test.ts server/src/lib/admin-auth-report.test.ts server/src/lib/user-migration.test.ts server/src/lib/office-network.test.ts server/src/lib/database-file.test.ts server/src/lib/office-setup.test.ts client/src/i18n/parity.test.ts
scripts.db:setup: prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && tsx prisma/seed.ts
